title: Exotic Garlicky Venezuelan Beef Empanadas
description: A garlicky and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring beef and applesauce, perfect for a date night, and can be cooked in a fondue pot for a fun and interactive experience. This recipe is low sodium friendly and uses a boil method for cooking.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot with olive oil to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, and paprika to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the applesauce and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook while preparing the empanada dough.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Carefully place the empanadas into the preheated fondue pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
